title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: Have you ever looked at the stars through a telescope?
sentences.zh: 你用望远镜看过星星吗？

sentences.en: A rover is exploring the surface of Mars.
sentences.zh: 一辆火星车正在探索火星表面。

sentences.en: Astronauts feel weightless on the space station.
sentences.zh: 宇航员在空间站里感觉失重。

sentences.en: It is hard to fall asleep when you float in the air.
sentences.zh: 在空中漂浮时很难入睡。

sentences.en: A rocket carries a satellite into space.
Voyager 1 is travelling far beyond the Earth.
sentences.zh: 旅行者 1 号正飞向远离地球的地方。

sentences.en: Countries should cooperate with each other in space.
sentences.zh: 各国在太空领域应该相互合作。

sentences.en: No human being has set foot on Mars yet.
sentences.zh: 还没有人类登上过火星。

sentences.en: Our galaxy has billions of stars.
sentences.zh: 我们的银河系有数十亿颗恒星。
